projets.pitch: Running a 2000 Windows game on modern Macs, from its original code and without a virtual machine.
projets.probleme: Zeus: Master of Olympus is a 32-bit Windows game that Apple Silicon Macs can no longer run. The usual answers are Wine or a virtual machine. This project runs the game's original code inside a small sandboxed x86 emulator and rewrites the Windows functions it needs as native code.
projets.role: Author and maintainer: reverse engineering, architecture, development, testing, releases and community.
points_forts: The real game, not a remake: same simulation, same save files.
Accuracy you can check: replayed scenarios compare every frame with a reference.
The game's file formats documented, with reference readers in Python.
A public roadmap towards a fully native engine, one part at a time.
A ready-to-run app, with no game files in the repository.

image.alt: A large city in wide mode, with the French interface

projets.contribuer: Try it on your Mac and report back, test another edition of the game, or pick a good first issue.

projets.pitch: This website, run as a project in its own right: open source, self-hosted and secure by design.
projets.probleme: Showing how I run a project and handle security, rather than describing it. The code is public; only the private area's content stays on the server.
projets.role: Scoping, architecture, security, development and operations.
points_forts: A roadmap in milestones, each with a checkable exit criterion.
Strict nonce-based CSP, HSTS, aiming for A+ on Mozilla Observatory and SSL Labs.
CI with CodeQL, Dependabot and Docker image scanning.
Personal private links that expire and can be revoked.
projets.contribuer: Report a vulnerability privately as described in the security policy, or open an issue for a mistake on the site.

projets.pitch: Taking over a wealth management firm's website and automating its publishing.
projets.probleme: A 187-page static site with no templates, edited by hand and uploaded over FTP. Any change to the menu or contact details had to be repeated on every page.
projets.role: Webmaster: site audit, checking tools, automated publishing.
points_forts: Automatic publishing to the host on every approved change.
A checker for links, images, sitemap and search index.
A backup before every change, with a documented rollback.
